1.o: December 1941 - December 1942: The tranquil lives of the citizens of Mobile, Alabama; Sacramento, California; Waterbury, Connecticut; and Luverne, Minnesota are shattered on December 7, 1941, as they, along with the rest of America, are thrust into the greatest cataclysm in history.

2.o: January 1943 - December 1943: Americans mobilize for total war at home and overseas. Factories hum around the clock, while in North Africa and then Italy, inexperienced GIs learn how to fight. Meanwhile, in the skies over Europe, thousands of American airmen gamble their lives against preposterous odds on daylight bombing missions.

3.o: November 1943 - June 1944: Americans are shocked by terrible losses on the Pacific atoll of Tarawa, while in Italy Allied forces are stalled for months at Monte Cassino, and a risky landing at Anzio fails utterly. At home, as overcrowded "war towns" boom, economic transformation leads to confrontation and ugly racial violence.

4.t: Pride of Our Nation / A Volunteer Basis
4.o: June 1944 - August 1944: On June 6, 1944, D-Day, 1.5 million Allied troops take part in the greatest invasion in history, but then bog down in the Norman hedgerows for weeks. Saipan proves the costliest Pacific battle to date, while back home dreaded telegrams from the War Department begin arriving at an inconceivable rate.

5.o: September 1944 - December 1944: Victory in Europe seems imminent, but in Holland, the Vosges Mountains, and the Hurtgen Forest, GIs learn painful lessons as old as war itself - that generals make plans, plans go wrong and soldiers die. Meanwhile, on the island of Peleliu, the Marines fight one of the most brutal and unnecessary battles of the Pacific.

6.o: December 1944 - March 1945: Americans are shocked by Hitler's massive counterattack in the Ardennes forest - but by mid-March, 1945, they are across the Rhine, while the Russians are 50 miles from Berlin. In the Pacific, after weeks of desperate fighting, Iwo Jima is secured, and American bombers begin a full-fledged air assault on Japan.

7.o: March 1945 - December 1945: A few weeks after the death of President Roosevelt shocks the country, Germany surrenders. Meanwhile, American sailors, soldiers and Marines endure the worst battle of the Pacific - Okinawa. In August, American planes drop atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, and the Japanese, too, surrender. Millions return home - to try to learn how to live in a world without war.

The Killer also notoriously married his 13-year-old second cousin, setting off an epic worldwide scandal.

2.o: يصل "ريس" إلى هدفه المحتمل الأول، ويطلب مساعدة "بن". ونظرًا للشكوك المحيطة بصحته العقلية، تقوم شراكة مضطربة بين "كاتي" و"ريس"، ولكنها مفيدة للطرفين للعثور على إجابات.

3.o: ينجرف "ريس" إلى عمق أكبر في مؤامرة معقدة ويضع اسمًا جديدًا على قائمته. في غضون ذلك، أعلنت وزيرة الدفاع "لورين هارتلي" عن إصلاح جذري في السياسة لمساعدة العملاء الخاصين. وتكتشف "كاتي" حقيقة ما يحدث في رأس "ريس".

4.o: يسافر "ريس" إلى "المكسيك" بمساعدة أقرب أصدقائه، لتحديد مكان القناص الذي قتل عائلته. تواصل "كاتي" بحثها من مكان بعيد. يتخذ "ستيف هورن" خطوات للحفاظ على صفقات "كابستون"، وتدخل فرقة البحث عن الهاربين التابعة لمكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي في "سان دييغو" بقيادة "توني لايون" المعركة بحثًا عن الضابط البحري المارق "جيمس ريس".

5.o: يسافر "ريس" إلى "سان فرانسيسكو" بحثًا عن إجابات بشأن عقار ربما يكون السبب في كل هذا. تحاول "كاتي" تحويل "مايك تديسكو" في محاولة لإفساد خطط "كابستون" الخاصة بـ"نوبيلام". يظل "توني" وفريقه بالقرب من "هورن"، على أمل اعتراض "ريس" قبل أن يقتل هدفه التالي.

6.o: تزداد مطاردة مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي احتدامًا مع اقترابهم من "ريس". تتفاقم أعراض "ريس" الجسدية والعقلية بدون الأدوية. يجب أن يهرب رجل متمرس في مهمته، محاطًا بمنفذي القانون، دون قتل الأبرياء.

7.o: يعود "ريس" إلى "كورونادو" للانتقام من الأشخاص الذين خانوه أكثر من غيرهم. وعندما عاد مرة أخرى داخل جدران منزل أسرته، تظهر ذكريات مجزأة. تراوغ "كاتي" مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي من أجل إنهاء قصتها.

8.o: تبدأ المواجهة في ضيعة جزيرة "أوركاس" لوزيرة الدفاع "هارتلي"، حيث تتعارض مسارات وأهداف "ريس" و"كاتي" و"بن" و"توني".

She suggests at the station that there must be something going on, yet no one takes her seriously. When she's bothered by something, it keeps her up at night. So she decides to investigate on her own. In the meantime, her boss, Captain Greg Young gets in touch with two of the big names in town. And they turn out to be...

6.o: The 5 of diamonds is put into an auction. This is one of the cards that were scattered all over the country due to the X-Blind when the Klondike Family attacked the Trapla palace. High Card must stop the card from falling into the wrong hands. They go on a secret mission to recover the 5 of diamonds on a luxury cruise ship where the auction takes place. But an extremely troublesome man for Pinochle, Norman Kingstat, is also participating in the auction.

7.o: When Finn and Chris approach Chelsea Hammond, the player of the 2 of diamonds, "Love Connection," she uses that power to stick their hands together. Chris, who has an important date coming up, chases Chelsea around all over town day and night with Finn to collect Chelsea's card and undo the power. But catching a girl with no fixed address turns out to be not so easy. Not having been able to undo the power, Chris goes on a date with Chris in tow.

8.o: To celebrate Lindsey's birthday, Finn visits Sun Fields. While preparing for the party, a couple of kids start to fight, and it looks like it is due to Sam, a boy who joined Sun Fields recently. Finn sees his old self in Sam, and tries to be there for him. And Lindsey's birthday party starts. It's all fun and merry, until Bobby Ball from the Klondike Family shows up.

9.o: The royal family has been attacked before when they are expecting to have a coronation, and the eldest prince, Dylan Fourland, has been killed. The mastermind of the attacked seems to be the Klondike Family, who is not afraid to make an enemy of the country to get the cards. Threatened by this, Pinochle secretly orders High Card to immediately collect cards whose whereabouts are known to them. But Finn is nowhere to be seen. He seems to be crestfallen over what happened to Sun Fields. Chris visits Finn’s place to cheer Finn up as his buddy.

10.o: Finn wakes up to find a woman standing in front of him. Her name is Aya Tawawa. She was a member of the first generation High Card, and is also a target of the secret mission for Finn. Aya happened to find Finn passed out and carried him in, but she feels a strange twist of fate with this encounter. She tells Finn about the incidents that happened with High Card, and what happened to Chris when he was young. In the meantime, Chris is being tortured by Jasper, and he learns that Alexander is going after Finn.

11.o: Why did Chris shoot Finn? Why did he steal the cards? What are his intentions? High Card is at a loss as to what to make of Chris' puzzling behavior that turned him into a fugitive. Finn suggests that they find Chris first on their own, but Leo disagrees, since Owen Alldays, Theodore's secretary, is working to secure Chris under the direct order of the president. In the meantime, the Klondike Family is preparing to invade as they try to rise in rebellion once again.

12.o: The Klondike Family makes a sudden attack on the palace. Leo and others have their hands full protecting Theodore and the royal family. Finn is apprehended by Owen on the account that he interfered with capturing Chris, and Chris drives off with Michel in the car. Then, Ban Klondike appears in front of Chris. Nhât, Sugar, Young, and Chelsea join the chase and the city is in absolute turmoil. Will High Card and Finn be able to stop Chris' X-Hand in time?

1.o: As the Boston Celtics' star defender and a civil rights leader, Bill finds himself playing defense beyond the hardwood amid segregation and competition.

2.o: Between fierce opponents and injustice all around, Bill helps the Celtics cement their dynasty.  A historic role change puts Bill in a position of power.

1.o: When Hammerson announces that he is going to test all the students to make sure they belong at the school, Arni is worried that he will fail: he is not a warrior!

2.o: Doomhild annoys everyone with her latest gadgets that allow her to be an excellent sailor without having to lift a finger.

3.o: During a Viking "astronomy" class, a metallic meteorite falls from the sky, lands at Erik's feet and makes the glyphs on his grandfather's sword glow.

4.o: When the naive Arni gives some culinary advice to Latouillette, the school's scary cook, he doesn't have time to say "wow" before he finds himself at the stove, "since it's so easy".

5.o: After spending years in the forest, Ylva is still having trouble adjusting to "civilization. She feels particularly challenged in Ms. Tendon's "diplomacy" class.

6.o: Not wanting to miss the school trip to the Trifröst Glade, Erik firmly denies having chevrite, a highly contagious disease, even though it is not true.

7.o: Arni hasn't slept in weeks, to the point that his health is suffering. At night, horrible screams emanate from the school basement.

8.o: At a "Career Day" to introduce students to different career options, Ylva wants to become a Valkyrie, like Turid - in other words, the Best of the Best.

9.o: At the Vikingskool, preparations for the Clan Assembly are well underway.

10.o: While Arni is on a mission to collect pebbles on the beach, he comes across a small pebble troll.

11.o: One morning, when they wake up, the students of the school realize that all the adults have disappeared!

12.o: Erik is tired of the misfortunes his family suffers, which he blames on bad luck. When he accidentally digs up what looks like a "lucky coin", he keeps it preciously for himself.

13.t: We Salute You, O Queen of the Turnips
13.o: As part of the turnip festival, the school always elects a turnip king and queen. This year, the competition is tough for the pretenders to the title of queen!

1.o: Fulfilling her father's wish, a young Cleopatra ascends the throne in Egypt amid sibling rivalries and forms an alliance with a noted Roman leader.

2.o: The birth of a child unites Rome and Egypt, putting Cleopatra in a favorable position until a shocking murder puts her and her son's lives under threat.

3.o: Cleopatra forges a strategic relationship for personal gains as Egypt thrives under her rule. Later, she makes a bold decision in the heat of battle.

4.o: While Octavian and the Roman army target Egypt, crises erupt on and off the battlefield. Can Cleopatra protect herself, her children and her empire?

1.o: An immature mother, Eun-mi, and her daughter, Jin-hee, live their daily lives like sisters. Jin-hee works at the Wolsan Police Station, and due to an incident, she is unjustly demoted to calm public opinion. Jin-hee goes home looking forward to drinking cold beer with her mother, but she sees something she had never imagined.

2.o: While doing her first patrol for the Namchon Police Station, Jin-hee hears a report of a burglary at their house, and Eun-mi manages to catch the culprit. However, upon hearing the reason for the theft and that the culprit will not be detained since it's his first offense, Eun-mi, the "neighborhood crazy bitch," takes matters into her own hands.

3.o: Eun-mi sees the wounds of Na Gyeong-ran, who came to the orthopedic clinic as a patient, and tells Jin-hee that domestic violence is suspected. Jin-hee even discovers the grandson of Na Gyeong-ran, who is suspected of having been assaulted by her parents, but it is difficult to separate them because they are her family. Enraged at the people beating her family, Eun-mi gets angry again.

4.o: Eun-mi, Mi-jung, and Jin-hee have a wonderful time together, sharing stories of the challenging moments when Eun-mi endured domestic violence. Eun-mi confides in Jin-hee, disclosing that it was Mi-jung who encouraged her to undergo an abortion. A few days later, Eun-mi and Jin-hee learn about the discovery of a deceased girl's body in the news.

5.o: After spotting an unknown man lurking near her house and observing her suite from a distance, Jin-hee decides to chase after him. She doesn’t realize then who this guy is, but she thinks he could be a possible suspect in the recent murder case. Meanwhile, Eun-mi unexpectedly encounters someone from her past, a former love interest, and his sudden reappearance after all these years deeply troubles her.

6.o: The startling revelation that the lurking individual is Jin-hee's father leaves her grappling with mixed emotions. Their initial meeting doesn't match her expectations, intensifying the overwhelming circumstances surrounding her life. In a candid conversation with Eun-mi, Jin-hee finds herself unable to hold back and finally shares her bottled-up feelings about being Eun-mi's daughter, leading to a heated and emotional discussion.

7.o: Jin Hee plans a trip to reconcile with Eun Mi. Little does she know, Eun Mi, seemingly with no intention of making amends, invites an unexpected guest. And so, some sort of family trip begins. As with most things, it appeared that time would resolve everything, but in a moment of complacency, Eun Mi finds herself in serious trouble.

8.o: Startled, Jin Hee rushes to her mother, putting the blame on Jin Hong for leaving Eun Mi in a vulnerable situation. Jin Hong stands there silently, not saying a word. During the gathering with her previous team, Jin Hee feels bothered by the story about senior Jae Won. After work, Jin Hee runs into the pregnant student from earlier, waiting for her just outside the station.

9.t: Between Maternal Aunt and Paternal Aunt
9.o: un Mi and Ji Eun, Jin Hong's younger sister, have fallen out and are not on good terms anymore. The tension between them escalates as soon as they run into each other at Jin Hong's residence. It doesn't take long before Jin Hee unexpectedly crosses paths with Ji Eun. Seeing how much Jin Hee has grown, Ji Eun can't help but develop an affection for her. Unaware of Ji Eun's relationship with Jin Hong, when Jin Hee sees Jin Hong and Ji Eun together, she immediately jumps to the conclusion that Jin Hong is being unfaithful to her mother.

10.o: The possibility of Eun Mi being in danger worries Jin Hee, as she believes that the true culprit could potentially cause harm to her at any given time and place. However, Jin Hee decides not to reveal the full extent of the situation to Eun Mi. Instead, she suggests that Eun Mi stay at Jin Hong's place. Eun Mi, however, does not react positively to this suggestion.

11.o: After the occurrence, Eun Mi becomes more attentive to Jin Hee, driven by the idea that Jin Hee could be left entirely on her own if something were to happen to Eun Mi. Jin Hee experiences a similar feeling and strives to be more accommodating. Jin Hong's parents, having become aware of Jin Hee's genuine status as their granddaughter and confirming it, wish to integrate themselves into her life much like they did with their own children. However, their method of doing so appears to be flawed. (Source: Viu)

12.o: Jin Hee harbored her inner frustrations silently, believing that being a dutiful daughter meant concealing her true feelings from her mother. Navigating unforeseen challenges, she has come to understand the value of opening up to others, particularly within her own family. Eun Mi, serving as Jin Hee's mother, has acted similarly and will continue to support her daughter in the same way. However, presently, both of them require a respite from their hectic lives.

1.o: After a tragic accident, Mickey Bolitar finds himself living with his aunt in Kasselton, New Jersey—a town with a lot of buried secrets. When a classmate disappears without a trace, Mickey's drawn into a conspiracy so shocking that it makes high school drama seem like a luxury…and leaves Mickey questioning everything about the life he thought he knew.

2.o: The investigation into Ashley's disappearance leads the gang to a dangerous man. As Mickey reunites with his mom, Shira bumps into an old friend. And in a town filled with secrets that people would kill to keep buried, what is Mrs. Friedman—Mickey's history teacher—hiding?

3.o: Mickey learns more about the mysterious Bat Lady's past. Shira spends time with an old friend, while Ema makes a new one. At Ellen and Alan Bolitar's 49th wedding anniversary party, the family struggles to come to grips with Brad's absence.

4.o: Mickey has a breakthrough in the search for Ashley. Chief Taylor has a tense confrontation with Bat Lady. Ema and Spoon make beautiful music together.

5.t: See Me Feel Me Touch Me Heal Me
5.o: Mickey and Spoon discover Ema's big secret. To find Ashley, Rachel needs a gigantic favor from Troy. Mickey and Rachel trail a suspect to a surprising location. Mickey finds a shocking photo.

6.o: Mickey makes an outlandish request. Shira finds herself in an awkward position. Ema reacts with rage to a betrayal. A major mystery is solved, but Mickey finds himself in over his head.

7.t: Sweet Dreams Are Made of This
7.o: Spoon, Ema, and Rachel take a road trip, while Mickey runs into someone he recently met.

8.o: Everything is revealed.

1.o: Kittle and Samuel discuss their motivation for a 49ers championship. St. Brown explains his upbringing, work ethic and goals for the season.

2.o: Jefferson describes his "Jets" persona and agonizes over his Week 2 play. Adams celebrates his daughter's birthday and suffers an injury during Week 4.

3.o: St. Brown has a career day after returning from an injury. Samuel deals with a fractured scapula. Adams becomes frustrated with his lack of targets.

4.o: St. Brown gets psyched to play against the Bears and his brother, Equanimeous. The Raiders make a coaching and quarterback change, reigniting Adams.

5.o: Samuel and Kittle gear up for a rematch of last season's NFC Championship game. Adams reunites with Aaron Rodgers, and Jefferson returns from injury.

6.o: St. Brown achieves a 1,500-yard season as the Lions win the division. Jefferson strives to hit 1,000 yards. Samuel and Kittle seek home-field advantage.

7.o: As the season ends for Adams and Jefferson, St. Brown and the Lions and Samuel, Kittle and the 49ers get set for their playoff run.

8.o: St. Brown and the Lions play in the NFC Conference Championship. Samuel and Kittle compete for the ultimate championship at Super Bowl LVIII.

1.o: Neslihan Turhan is a TV show host at the pinnacle of her career who chases unsolved murders and hidden secrets in front of millions of viewers on her show Tek Gerçek (One Truth). However, the new murder case she has taken on will turn her life upside down.

2.o: Neslihan becomes hopeful, believing that she has discovered Lal's murderer. However, the allegations made by Salih complicate the events even more.

3.o: With all eyes fixed on Neslihan, she needs to make a decision—will she invite Can, her son, on her show to face millions of viewers or not?

1.o: يبدأ "هاب هالوران" رحلته كقصة انتقام اعتيادية، لكنه سرعان ما يدرك أنه قد يكون عالقاً في قصة خارقة للطبيعة.

2.o: يكتشف "هاب" المزيد عن وظيفته الجديدة في خدمة الشيطان ويواجه أول شيطان في طريقه.

3.o: يحاول "هاب" إشعال الخصام بين "كيد" و"لاكي"، لكنه يستخدمه كتضليل أثناء مطاردته لشيطان آخر.

4.o: تنطلق "ماريان" في مهمة لتوبيخ "هاب" بسبب إيذائه لـ"كايد"، لكنها تجد نفسها فجأة في عالم الشياطين.

5.o: تنكشف الدوافع العاطفية التي جعلت "ميدج" تنضم إلى "بوت وجولد". في هذه الأثناء، يبدأ "هاب" في جمع خيوط لغز أكبر ويحاول إقناع "ميدج" بمساعدته.

6.o: ينفّذ "لاكي" انتقامه من "هاب"، لكنه يجد نفسه عالقاً في معركة مع الشياطين.

7.o: يحاول "هاب" و"ميدج" معاً منع نهاية العالم.

8.o: بعد أن فقد أعز ما يملك، يُجبر "هاب" أخيراً على مواجهة أعظم خطاياه. ينطلق في محاولة أخيرة للخلاص، ساعياً لإيقاف قوة شيطانية أُطلقت من الجحيم.

1.o: Yi-rang, James, and Gu-ho take down another villain. Out of nowhere, Gu-ho announces he's leaving the con game and walking away from the team.

2.o: Yi-rang and Gu-ho head to the Philippines to avenge James, who's in a coma. Tae-su blocks land and sea. Their only chance now is an aerial attack!

3.o: Gu-ho discovers a hidden side of Mr. Famous, the hottest name in art criticism. But strangely, Yi-rang seems reluctant to join the con.

4.o: A painting finally sees the light of day, stirring up chaos at an auction. Meanwhile, Yi-rang slips away alone, chasing traces of a buried memory.

5.o: After a nightmare, Gu-ho meets an unexpected figure. Meanwhile, Chairwoman Lee hears of Dr. Rachel, a VVIP concierge doctor, and tails James.

6.o: Seong-woo learns Yi-rang's secret, prompting her to make a shocking announcement. Gwang-sik's return gives Chairwoman Lee one last chance.

7.o: A familiar woman appears before a disgraced James. Meanwhile, the trio enlists a popular influencer to help punish Gil Beauty, the queen of lawsuits.

8.o: The sad tale of Un-nyun and Big Noggin is revealed. Something clicks for Gil Beauty, leading her to a village where locals share one thing in common.

9.o: Ha Jung-ho is a corrupt seafood tycoon and cinephile. When he doesn't easily invest, Yi-rang comes up with a new plan—surely not a honey trap?

10.o: Jung-ho agrees to invest on one condition—a full script overhaul. He wants to write, produce, direct, and act. Yi-rang's motive is finally revealed.

11.o: The trio drifts apart, and each carries on with their own life. Yi-rang misses James and Gu-ho, but still plots to reach Kang Yo-seop alone.

12.o: The trio lures Yo-seop to the final feast. But Gu-ho is shot, and Yi-rang and James are captured. Who will the goddess of victory smile upon?

1.o: حالة طارئة لم يسبق لها مثيل تفرض العزل على "فيربانكس". يجمع "فرانك" كل الموارد المتاحة لمجابهتها على جميع الأصعدة.

2.o: يحاول "لوك" العودة إلى الدار في ظل احتدام مطاردة "هافلوك". يفكّر "فرانك" ما إن كان ينبغي الرضوخ لمجموعة من المطالب.

3.o: اختفاء "سارة" يضفي طابعاً من الإلحاح على بحث "فرانك". يأخذ مخطط "هافلوك" الرئيسي منحنى غير متوقع، رافعاً عدد الرهائن.

4.o: مع اختفاء إحدى مجندات الولاية، يتّسع نطاق تحقيق "فرانك". ينضم محلّيان مسلّحان إلى مطاردة الهاربين. تزداد مخاوف "سارة" حول مكان "لوك".

5.o: يركّز "فرانك" على تعقّب "لوك". يزداد انخراط "وكالة المخابرات المركزية" مع دخول مخطط "هافلوك" إلى مرحلة جديدة.

6.t: The Devil Wears a Suit and Tie
6.o: تُضرب "فيربانكس" بانقطاع الكهرباء على نطاق واسع. ترى "سارة" شخصاً مريباً في قسم الطوارئ. تحاول "سيدني" فرض سيطرتها على دليل محوري.

7.o: يُحقق مع مشتبه فيه جديد غامض. يُكشف سرّ "فرانك". يسعى "هافلوك" إلى استعادة محتويات قرصه الصلب.

8.o: تكتشف "سيدني" خبايا ماضي أبيها وبروتوكول "آتووتر" والمعلومات السرّية التي يتضمّنها "الأرشيف السادس".

9.o: تهبط "برادفورد" في "فيربانكس" مع فرقة عمليات من "وحدة المخابرات المركزية" ونصب عينيها هدف رئيسي جديد. تقدم "سيدني" على محاولة يائسة لكشف الحقيقة.

10.o: يخاطر "هافلوك" و"سيدني" بكلّ شيء للاستحواذ على الأرشيف. ينطلق "فرانك" في مهمة لإنقاذ حياة.

1.o: تحاول "غولدي" إيجاد الهدية المثالية لـ"تيني". يجتمع أصدقاء "غولدي" لمساعدتها على الخروج من أزمتها العالقة.

2.o: عندما تدرك "تيني" أنها قصيرة على ألعاب الملاهي، تحاول أن تصبح أطول. يختفي الصديق الوهمي لـ"بيتي".

3.t: The Hiding Spot / Frand or Foe
3.o: تواجه "غولدي" صعوبة في لعب الغميضة مثل أصدقائها. تلجأ "غولدي" إلى حل مبتكر عندما تجد صعوبة في دخول منزل "تيني" للمشاركة في حفل مبيت.

4.t: Birds of a Feather / Mayor Teeny
4.o: تعمل "غولدي" جاهدة لتجد صديقاً مقرباً للجميع. تتولى "تيني" وظيفة مهمة ليوم واحد.

5.o: تشعر "غولدي" بالإلهام عندما تتبنى "تيني" قطة، وتبحث "غولدي" عن حيوان أليف خاص بها. تصنع "غولدي" زياً لعطلة ربيعية سحرية.

6.o: تبحث السيدة "بيتونيا" عن منزل جديد. عندما يتوقّف "بيتي" عن تصديق وجود المخلوقات الفضائية، تحاول "غولدي" إعادة إحياء ذلك السحر.

7.o: تنضم "غولدي" إلى الجوقة، لكنها تقلق من أن صوتها صاخب. عند عثور "غولدي" على بيضة في عشها، تبذل جهدها للاعتناء بها.

8.o: تهب "غولدي" لتقديم المساعدة بشخصيتها البطولية الجديدة. تشارك صديقة كبيرة "غولدي" في مشاعرها الجياشة.

9.o: تبتكر "تيني" لعبة، لكن قواعدها أكثر من اللازم. تحلم "غولدي" بكابوس وتواجه خوفاً جديداً.

10.t: Goldie on a Roll / Big Time Trouble
10.o: يجتمع أصدقاء "غولدي" لصنع زلاجات عملاقة. تسافر "غولدي" في الزمن لإصلاح لحظة محرجة.

11.o: مع اقتراب حفل عشاء العمدة، تقلق "غولدي" من أنها ليست أنيقة بما يكفي. تعاني "غولدي" لتعتني بنفسها في غياب "روميو".

12.o: تترك جنية الأسنان مفاجأة مميزة لـ"غولدي". تشعر "غولدي" بالحزن عندما تخبرها "وولي" بخبر صعب.

13.o: تكتب "غولدي" و"روميو" أغنية جديدة جذابة تكتسح "بويزنبيرغ". مفاجأة ثلجية تثير حماساً كبيراً.

1.o: يفرض أب قاسٍ سلطته على الأخوين "آدم" و"تشارلز" ابنَي عائلة "تراسك"، فيُضطران إلى سلك طريقين متضادين نحو مرحلة النضج... أحدهما يرحل إلى بلاد بعيدة، بينما يلازم الآخر الديار.

2.o: تستعيد "كاثي" ذكريات ماضيها المظلم، بينما يشعل وجودها داخل منزل الشقيقين خلافًا بينهما في الحاضر.

3.o: بينما يسعى "آدم" إلى تحقيق حلم بناء بيت وتكوين أسرة في "كاليفورنيا"، تتبلور أفكار "كاثي" الخاصة بشأن المستقبل.

4.o: تحظى "كاثي" ببداية جديدة وحياة أخرى باسم مختلف، وتضع خطة لا تعرف الرحمة لتحقيق الاستقلال المادي.

5.o: بعد مرور عشر سنوات، تغيّر مواجهة مع "كاثي" وجهة نظر "آدم"، بينما يتصادم مع "لي" بشأن إخبار الصبيين بحقيقة والدتهما.

6.o: يبدأ "آدم" مشروعًا تجاريًا جريئًا وجديدًا. وينجذب "كال" المنعزل إلى ماضي أسرته، في حين يعود ماضي "كاثي" ليطاردها من جديد.

7.o: بينما تلوح الحرب العالمية الأولى في الأفق، تتساءل الأسرة عمّا إذا كان محو خطايا الماضي ممكنًا... وما إذا كان جيل جديد مبتلًى بتكرارها.
